name: tqabench
description: TQABench is a benchmark for question answering over tabular and structured data, measuring a model's ability to interpret tables and produce correct answers. It contains diverse table-question pairs that test extraction, aggregation, and reasoning over tabular content. The benchmark is intended to evaluate robustness of models on table-grounded QA tasks.
reputation: A niche but useful dataset in the table/question-answering community; used in specialized research on table-grounded QA but not as widely adopted as major text-only QA benchmarks.
